description.value:
A mutated bird or bat-thing with a wider wingspan than it has any right to. Built for the long trail and the high vantage.

SIGNATURE — can scout well ahead of the party and report back; by Alpha stage, you can briefly see through its eyes on demand.

cinderfall.incomplete: The "see through its eyes" clause is the same gap as One Mind, Two Bodies above (confirmed absent even in Summoner/Eidolon). ---. This effect buffs, protects, or grants actions to the Feral Bond (the companion beast) from the holder's own card. No rule-element selector in pf2e-source lets one actor's item grant a stat bonus, temp HP, an extra action, or a shared sense to a different actor's sheet -- confirmed by spot-checking real pf2e's own fully-built Animal Companion subsystem (Ranger/Druid), where virtually every companion-buff/companion-action-economy feat ships with rules: [] too. Feral Bond growth stages (Whelp / Bonded / Alpha / Apex-Touched, classes.waywarden.json:95 terms) have no tracked data field anywhere in the corpus, so a stage requirement like "at least Alpha stage" has no roll option or actor property to predicate against.
